design.hypothesis: Undocumented numeric flight-ID relative order may retain plan-generation chronology; not a timestamp or IFPLID claim.
design.views: 2025 January/July original monthly training inputs; accepted old January/July2026 ranking only; no final view.
design.targets: No BLOCK_TIME_UTC_mvt or TAXITIME_SEC_mvt projection, loading, association, or model fit.
design.reference: Within each movement UTC month, unique positive integral IDs <=2**53 with exactly one DEP, <=one ARR, consistent route, and <=one known value per plan clock.
design.missing: Null/invalid IDs, phase duplicates, cross-endpoint null mismatches, conflicting clocks/routes reported separately. Missing clocks remain missing; no schedule fill.
design.rank: ID percentile among eligible departures in its month; clock rank only among rows with that clock; average tie ranks for Spearman. Raw absolute ID never enters a model.
design.endpoint: Within-month same-ID DEP/ARR only; clock equality and null disagreement are descriptive checks, not matching proof; cross-month endpoints are not available.
design.chronology: All-month Spearman plus fixed-date and fixed-date x origin Spearman, >=100 valid observations per supported group. Report both clocks independently.
design.format_checks: Decimal digit lengths and first-three-decimal-digit frequency by month/origin are diagnostics only. Report month-relative ID rank quartiles by origin and clock-rank quintile.

falsification.meaning: Necessary evidence for simple monotonic chronology only; passing does not establish creation time, stale-plan detection, incremental target information, or CV gain.
falsification.missing_support: Fail feasibility; no threshold repair or alternative encoding search.

review: Root and error_mechanisms static review passed before metadata-only freeze. No source chronology or targets read.
execution: Pending explicit clean desktop handoff; /usr/bin/time -v timeout 60s, one thread; no threshold/format retries.
